scope: Documentation/artifact only. This is an author verification/cleanup receipt, not independent code/architecture approval or native lifecycle evidence.
behavior_lock: 72focused observer/corrector regressions and targeted lint/format/strict mypy/compile passed before actual correction on unchanged reviewed identities; current retained-data delta/gate/preservation checks after edits.
cleanup_result: NO-OP: no executable changes, masking fallback, new abstraction/dependency, duplicated observer, generalized repair or score relaxation. Current v1/v2 labels and historical cutoffs clarified; frozen harness warnings/results not rewritten.

verification.paired_gate_preceded_scoring: Retained independent paired-output-acceptance.json plus root-paired-output-gate.json and scorer-execution.json retain chain; no re-execution

independent_reviews_separate: Actual code-reviewer and architect own their verdicts. Preparation approvals do not replace actual-data checks; author does not self-approve.
not_run: unnecessary repeated unit/full suite or browser
Git staging/commit/push or fresh remote verification
